description: Check adaptive page shadows, the theme color-picker sheet, and centered command-bar shadow.
preconditions: Build and package the exact candidate as an isolated Dev app with the mock Keychain.
Use a plain light page and a plain dark page to distinguish the page edge from its effect.
steps: Open Appearance and find Page edge. Verify only Border and Shadow are shown. Border spans 0–6; Shadow offers Default, None, and Customize.
Change Border between 0 and 6. Inspect every corner and verify the ordinary page does not reflow.

Select Default. In light window chrome verify centered black at 20% opacity, 24 px blur, and zero spread. In dark window chrome verify active Space accent at 12% opacity, 48 px blur, and 4 px spread, centered. Change Space/accent and system appearance in Auto; verify live updates without rewriting the saved custom style.

Choose Customize. Verify the shared sheet opens with opacity, blur, X/Y offsets, spread, and the theme wheel/hex color picker. Close without editing; verify selected mode is unchanged. Reopen, edit each control, verify live changes and Custom selection. Reopen Customize while already Custom. Set Blur 0 and positive spread; verify no opaque source shape.
Create a side-by-side split and switch the focused pane. Inspect both pages and the divider for selection outlines and unwanted shadow over the pages. Repeat with a stacked split when available.
Collapse the sidebar, hide the top bar, resize the window and enter and exit fullscreen. Check that the shadow follows the page corners and remains outside the page.

Select None then Default. Verify Border and cached custom values remain saved. Open the command bar and verify its shadow is horizontally centered with a 2 px vertical offset, with existing blur and opacity and Shadows switch preserved.
Set a custom border and tinted glow. Quit normally and relaunch the same profile, then reopen Settings and verify the saved controls and visible effect.
Stop the isolated app normally and inspect for a new matching crash report.
observables: The default page has rounded corners, no decorative hairline, and a centered shadow that follows window chrome mode and Space accent independently of website appearance.
Border is independently adjustable from 0 to 6 logical pixels. Page margin retains the previous frame-inset behavior.
The effect is behind all pages and never washes over page content, including transparent content. Split focus and capture outlines remain meaningful.
Managed and unavailable preferences reject edits without changing saved values.
The custom border and all shadow values survive normal relaunch; teardown produces no new matching crash.
